title: Favourite
description: A dish the user marked as a favourite, own or shipped. A stored personal record, one per dish; its id is favourite-, the origin and the dish id. A mark and no more: no date, no count, no order.

origin.description: Where the dish lives: own (the user's notebook) or shipped (the collection the app ships). The ids of the two are not disjoint.

dish.description: The id of the dish: a shipped dish's id, or the family id of an own dish (the id of its first version).
